title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Huang’s Nvidia Return
title_cn: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Huang’s Nvidia Return
summary:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF

Nvidia jumped as much as 37% for its best intraday gain in over a quarter century. The surge added more than $1 trillion to the chipmaker’s market capitalization, the largest such single-day increase for any company recorded by Bloomberg. It came after Nvidia’s biggest weekly drop since 2008, a decline sparked by Huang’s ouster following the disclosure of his affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
